newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Anglo believes can overcome EU hurdles.
newsitem.headline: Anglo believes can overcome EU hurdles.

text.p: Anglo American Corp of South Africa Ltd said on Tuesday it beleived it could work out a deal with the European Union over its stake in Lonrho Plc.

"As for the European Union merger regulations...I am confident that we will be able to come to a satisfactory arrangement with the European Union," chairman Julian Ogilvie Thompson told a results briefing.
"We've always realised that in acquiring Lonrho (we would encounter difficulties with acquiring their platinum interests). We have no intention of doing that," he said.
"Amplats (Anglo American Platinum Corp of South Africa Ltd) is quite capable of competing with Lonrho Platinum."

EU Competition Commissioner Karel Van Miert said earlier on Tuesday that Anglo's acquisition of a controlling stake in Lonrho would have problems getting clearance under EU competition rules, but he hoped the companies would provide a solution.
Earlier this year Brussels blocked the merger of the platinum interests of Lonrho and South African mining group Gencor, warning Anglo at the time about taking control of Lonrho.
